i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.day_quality: domain: 'what does this account-day's number stand on'. MEASURED (the form computed and the guard agreed) | FLOW_UNRECONCILED (the form and the holdings-plus-income cross-check disagree beyond the measured tolerance) | LARGE_FLOW (the flow is a large share of the base; the value still enters) | NOT_MEASURABLE (no return is computable INSIDE the book -- non-positive prior value, or outside the plausibility band) | SOURCE_LAG (the custodian has not delivered the day). Covered by subtraction: a day is either emitted or not; an emitted day either has a computable base or not (NOT_MEASURABLE); a computable day either reconciles (MEASURED / LARGE_FLOW) or not (FLOW_UNRECONCILED); a day the feed has not delivered is SOURCE_LAG. A day BEFORE the account's first positive value is emitted as NO ROW AT ALL, which is why the domain says 'account-day' and not 'trading day' -- that case is outside the domain rather than a sixth member (ISSUER AMENDMENT 1).
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.return_basis: domain: 'which arithmetic produced total_return_daily'. TWR (the C-METHOD form) | HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK (price return plus income, served when the guard refuses the form) | NOT_MEASURABLE (no number is served). Exhaustive by construction: the column is null iff the value is NOT_MEASURABLE.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.history_scope: domain: 'how much of this account's life does the table hold'. FULL | PARTIAL_HISTORY. Every round-1 row carries PARTIAL_HISTORY because the emit is a QA thread over six accounts and the all-accounts run is round 2; FULL is declared now so the value exists when that run lands, rather than being added as a schema change then.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every member of day_quality and return_basis is an ACCOUNT-DAY property; history_scope is an ACCOUNT property carried onto each of its rows. The two grains are separate columns and neither is folded into the other.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: day_quality answers HOW MUCH TO TRUST the day; return_basis answers WHAT THE NUMBER IS. They are deliberately not one axis: a FLOW_UNRECONCILED day still serves a number (the fallback), and a LARGE_FLOW day serves the form's own number. Collapsing them would make 'served a fallback' and 'flagged as large' the same kind of fact, which they are not.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: Name which values one remedy does NOT move. Finding a missing flow or price moves FLOW_UNRECONCILED to MEASURED; it does NOT move LARGE_FLOW (nothing 'fixes' a genuinely large flow -- it is a reader's warning), and it does NOT move NOT_MEASURABLE where the base is non-positive (no amount of data gives an account a positive prior value it did not have). The feed landing moves SOURCE_LAG and nothing else. Three members, three disjoint remedies.

token_census._method: comp-find '\b<VALUE>\b' data infra/aws/lambda portal/src, run 2026-09-30 ~18:1xZ. 'hits' is the total across the scope; 'def_band' is the number of matches on a DEFINITION line, which is the number that decides a collision -- a prose mention is not a competing definition.
token_census._denominator: 12876 file(s) scanned in scope [corpus=all]; 4800 EPHEMERAL-FLOOR and 2011 BINARY files not searched, both printed by the tool.

FULL.why: the only other definition is a vendored pyiceberg constant whose VALUE is the lowercase string 'full'; it shares the identifier, not the served value, and it is a third-party dependency this estate does not author.

PARTIAL_HISTORY.why: sole definition is this contract's producer.

foreign_definitions: data/assets/scripts/gold/cottonwood_aua.py:71 (comment only, not a definition of this token)
MEASURED.why: THE NEAREST NEIGHBOUR, named rather than counted: the cot ingest defines a DIFFERENT string ('MEASURED-COMPLETE'), and the two portal harnesses carry status: 'MEASURED' on a SECURITY IDENTITY -- a different object, a different axis, and a different column. No consumer reads both through one field. The 1,183 total is dominated by the English word in prose across this estate's own documentation, which a word-boundary census cannot separate from a value and which no typed column confuses.

FLOW_UNRECONCILED.why: sole definition is this contract's producer.

LARGE_FLOW.why: sole definition is this contract's producer.

NOT_MEASURABLE.why: sole definition is this contract's producer; it is declared on two axes (day_quality and return_basis) BY DESIGN, and those two uses agree -- the column is null exactly when both carry it.

SOURCE_LAG.why: sole definition is this contract's producer; the value is also a C-COVERAGE member the PRD declares, which is the same meaning at the project grain.

TWR.why: the sole DEFINITION is this contract's producer. The other 125 hits are prose plus the RETIRING engine's own names (twr_daily, c02_twr_engine, TRUE_TWR), which C-SHADOW retires and which are table and module names rather than a competing enum value. The overlap therefore shrinks over time rather than growing, and no consumer resolves a return_basis through a table name.

HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK.why: sole definition is this contract's producer.

FEE_RAIL_UNUSED.why: sole definition is this contract's producer; also a C-COVERAGE member and a C-FEERAIL term the PRD declares, the same meaning at the project grain.

NO_HOLDINGS_ROW.why: sole definition is this contract's producer.

HOLDINGS_NOT_OK.why: sole definition is this contract's producer.

rule24_record.token_census_method: comp-find '\b<VALUE>\b' over data, infra/aws/lambda, portal/src; word-boundary; denominator 12,876 files scanned in corpus=all (4,800 ephemeral-floor and 2,011 binary files not searched, both printed by the tool).
rule24_record.token_census_finding: NO COMPETING ENUM DEFINITION EXISTS for any of the thirteen values: every value's DEF band resolves to this contract's own producer, with two exceptions that are not collisions -- FULL's other DEF is a vendored pyiceberg constant whose VALUE is lowercase 'full', and MEASURED's other DEFs are a different string ('MEASURED-COMPLETE' in the cot bronze ingest) and a portal SecurityAnalysis harness that carries status: 'MEASURED' on a SECURITY IDENTITY, a different axis and a different object. The three high-count tokens (MEASURED 1,183, FULL 297, TWR 126) are LEXICALLY common and SEMANTICALLY unique here; a consumer rejects on the typed column, not on the token. TWR's 126 hits are overwhelmingly the RETIRING engine's own names (twr_daily, c02_twr_engine) which C-SHADOW retires, so that overlap shrinks rather than grows.

schema_hash_basis: sha256 over the sorted 'name:type' lines joined by newline, types as the pyarrow type name the producer's ARROW_SCHEMA carries. The check recomputes it against the landed parquet, so contract and artifact cannot drift.
firm_specific_columns: NONE. A firm-specific column is a contract violation (C-SHAPE); no sb_cd, tr_cd or any Schwab code survives into this table -- they live only in the adapter's sources.json.
